steps.body: Two different sums can stand on the two sides: 3 + 6 = 4 + 5. Both are worth nine, so the equation is true.
steps.narration: Two different sums can stand on the two sides: 3 + 6 = 4 + 5. Both are worth nine, so the equation is true.

widget.prompt: Check 3 + 6 = 4 + 5: value the right side. Start at 4 and count on 5. Where do you land?
widget.missFeedback: Start at 4 and count on 5: you land on 9.
widget.successFeedback: Landed on 9 — the right sum is 9, the same nine the left sum makes. Two sums, one value.
